title: VMware vSphere / VCF - Datastores
description: Selected datastore(s) / datastore cluster(s): capacity, provisioning, accessibility, performance seen by the ESX hosts.

targets.expr: count((vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})) or vector(0)

sum((vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

sum((vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

1 - sum((vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})) / sum((vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

sum((vmware_datastore_provisioned_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})) / sum((vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

count((1 - (vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}) / (vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})) > 0.85) or vector(0)

count((vmware_datastore_is_accessible{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Hosts without access
panels.description: Sum over the datastores of the ESX hosts that mount it but cannot access it (APD / PDL...).

targets.expr: sum((vmware_datastore_hosts_inaccessible{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Datastores (click a datastore / datastore cluster to open it)

targets.expr: max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name, type, shared, datastore_cluster) (vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) ((vmware_datastore_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) ((vmware_datastore_is_accessible{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) ((vmware_datastore_in_maintenance{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) ((vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) ((vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) ((1 - (vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}) / (vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) ((vmware_datastore_provisioned_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}) / (vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) ((vmware_datastore_uncommitted_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) ((vmware_datastore_hosts_mounted{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) ((vmware_datastore_hosts_inaccessible{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) ((vmware_datastore_vms_hosted{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

(1 - (vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}) / (vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

(vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})

panels.title: Provisioned / capacity
panels.description: Thin provisioning: above 100%, the VMs could fill the datastore if they grew to their full size.

targets.expr: (vmware_datastore_provisioned_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}) / (vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})

(1 - (vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}) / (vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name"} and on(vcenter, datastore_moid) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}))

panels.title: Datastore clusters (click one to open it)

targets.expr: max by (vcenter, dc_name, datastore_cluster) (vmware_datastore_cluster_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, datastore_cluster) (vmware_datastore_cluster_datastores{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, datastore_cluster) (vmware_datastore_cluster_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, datastore_cluster) (vmware_datastore_cluster_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})

max by (vcenter, dc_name, datastore_cluster) (1 - vmware_datastore_cluster_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"} / vmware_datastore_cluster_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"})

1 - vmware_datastore_cluster_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"} / vmware_datastore_cluster_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}

panels.title: Latency (worst ESX host)
panels.description: From the ESX datastore.* real-time counters, per datastore instance (UUID resolved through the datastore URL): VMFS and vSAN datastores; empty for datastores without a .../volumes/<uuid>/ URL.

targets.expr: max by (vcenter, ds_name) (vmware_host_perf_datastore_total_read_latency_average_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", perf_instance!=""} * on(vcenter, perf_instance) group_left(ds_name) max by (vcenter, perf_instance, ds_name) (label_replace(vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster", url=~".*/volumes/.+"}, "perf_instance", "$1", "url", ".*/volumes/([^/]+)/?")))

max by (vcenter, ds_name) (vmware_host_perf_datastore_total_write_latency_average_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", perf_instance!=""} * on(vcenter, perf_instance) group_left(ds_name) max by (vcenter, perf_instance, ds_name) (label_replace(vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster", url=~".*/volumes/.+"}, "perf_instance", "$1", "url", ".*/volumes/([^/]+)/?")))

panels.title: Active alarms on the datastore(s) / datastore cluster(s)
panels.description: Active (triggered) vCenter alarms. Only present when an alarm is active.

targets.expr: (vmware_alarm_triggered{vcenter=~"$vcenter", entity_type="Datastore"} and on(vcenter, entity) label_replace(vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", ds_name=~"$ds_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}, "entity", "$1", "ds_name", "(.*)")) or (vmware_alarm_triggered{vcenter=~"$vcenter", entity_type="StoragePod"} and on(vcenter, entity) label_replace(vmware_datastore_cluster_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", datastore_cluster=~"$datastore_cluster"}, "entity", "$1", "datastore_cluster", "(.*)"))
